name: exact_org_explicit_false
spec: Returns False when a fact entry whose `org` equals `lead_org` (case-insensitive, whitespace collapsed) has `on_resume` explicitly false — the user took that activity off every resume; the Leadership section is then left out of every resume.

name: exact_org_explicit_true
spec: Returns True otherwise: `on_resume` true, missing, or any value other than the boolean false; no entry with that org; an empty or missing `lead_org` (then there is no section to decide); `entries` empty / None.
